blocks.text: Then the Satguru gave direct command to the Majha Singhs and first expanded the Khalsa before setting loose open conflict. (25)
The Bhujangis were first drawn in and strengthened through pahul, and from them arose the body of armed Nihangs. (26)
Some remained near the gurdwaras, some built dharamsals and bungas, and the Bhujangis kept themselves distinct from others. (27)
